title: Palm biodiesel blend dispatch
description: Two-stage stochastic unit commitment and economic dispatch for an isolated diesel-photovoltaic-battery microgrid, run separately across nine palm biodiesel blends (B0 to B100) under solar-uncertainty scenarios. Includes the model, input data, sweep scripts, and the scripts that build every table and figure in the associated study. The study is under review; its reference will be added to this record on publication.
